entries.name: The Center for Community Action and Environmental Justice (CCAEJ)
entries.summary: a progressive equity-based organization that embodies hope, unites people y pueblos, to create intersectional solutions that transform communities “to bring people together to improve their social and natural environment.” Utilizing the lens of environmental health, we achieve regenerative change by developing resilient BIPOC intergenerational leadership, through the power of community base-building. Through strategic campaigns, we cultivate inclusive self-sustaining neighborhoods, where everyone can live, work, play, and thrive.

entries.name: The People’s Collective for Environmental Justice (PC4EJ)
entries.summary:
Dedicated to educating and empowering communities through research, public awareness, and capacity-building efforts focused on environmental justice. 
Our mission is to advance knowledge, resources, and community-led solutions to address pollution, environmental challenges, and inequitable development practices impacting our communities.

entries.name: Inland Coalition for Immigrant Justice
entries.summary: The ICIJ, is composed of over 35 organizations that serve the immigrant community in the Inland Empire. The IC4IJ currently focuses on advocacy, changing the narrative, and capacity building. Our coalition engages in policy advocacy, community organizing and education, and rapid response to ICE and border patrol operations. We are collectively changing the narrative of the one million immigrants who live, thrive, and are a foundational part of the fabric of the IE. We are building organizational capacity through leadership development, cooperation, support networks, and shared regional strategies. Lastly, the IC4IJ provides resources such as training, technical support, and grants to coalition partners to further support their efforts and mission in the region.

entries.name: The Coalition for Humane Immigrant Rights (CHIRLA)
entries.summary: CHIRLA is a California leader with national impact made of diverse immigrant families and individuals who act as agents of social change to achieve a world with freedom of mobility, full human rights, and true participatory democracy. CHIRLA’s mission is to achieve a just society fully inclusive of immigrants.

entries.name: The Inland Empire Immigrant Youth Collective
entries.summary: As an undocumented youth-led grassroots organization, we are deeply committed to creating meaningful change within our community. Our programs address the unique challenges faced by immigrant youth, fostering an environment of growth, healing, and empowerment. From building a supportive community to engaging in civic action, our programs and services nurture, educate, and inspire.

entries.name: Omnitrans
entries.summary: Omnitrans is the public transit agency serving the San Bernardino Valley, providing safe, reliable, affordable, friendly and environmentally responsible transportation. Omnitrans currently operates local and express bus routes, sbX bus rapid transit service, and Access, a paratransit service for the disabled.

entries.name: MetroLink
entries.summary: Metrolink is proud to serve as the LINK between six Southern California counties with safe, seamless and reliable transportation and connectivity. By reducing 9.2 million car trips annually, Metrolink has proven to be an effective solution, taking pressure off freeways and reducing gridlock.

entries.name: RideSplits
entries.summary: Ride Splits makes carpooling easy for students and everyday commuters by helping you set a usual route, match with RideBuddies, and coordinate multi‑stop trips within campus communities or for events. You choose who rides with you and pay securely in the app while drivers receive weekly payouts. It’s a smoother, community‑based way to cut costs, save time, and reduce emissions.

entries.name: Inland Empire Charter and Transportation Service
entries.summary: Since 1983, Inland Empire has been operating charter bus programs for many groups throughout the Greater California Region and beyond. Our experience throughout the years make us the BEST choice to handle the transportation portion of your special occasion and group outing!

entries.name: Party Bus
entries.summary: As a leading transportation provider in the Inland Empire, you can count on us to handle all your group travel needs!

entries.name: El Corre Caminos
entries.summary: El Corre Caminos was founded in 1991 to connect the Inland Empire with the San Ysidro border in a timely manner. There were, and still are other alternatives, but none match our level of service or get to your destination in a timely manner like we do.

entries.name: Ontario International Airport
entries.summary: Ontario International Airport offers up to 90 daily nonstop flights to nearly 30 destinations, including New York, Las Vegas, Mexico and more. Get real-time updates for arrivals and departures while enjoying shorter security wait times compared to other airports in Southern California.

entries.name: San Bernardino Interational Airport
entries.summary: Experience the newest way to travel out of the Inland Empire! Start your next journey at San Bernardino International Airport and skip the traffic, long lines, and high parking costs of other LA Basin airports.

entries.name: i9  Kids Sports Programs
entries.summary: Discover organized youth sports leagues in Fontana, Rialto, Jurupa Valley, and Norco! i9 Sports provides high-quality youth flag football, soccer, basketball, baseball, tennis, volleyball, and cheer programs for kids ages 3 to 15. We eliminate the stress of youth sports with a family-friendly one-day-a-week commitment. Practice and games take place on the same day at top local parks and fields near you, keeping your weeknights free. Our inclusive programs feature equal playing time, age-appropriate instruction, and a strong focus on core sportsmanship values like teamwork, respect, and integrity. Perfect for beginners and returning players alike, our recreational sports leagues require no draft, no tryouts, and no extra travel. If you want a fun, positive, and safe youth sports experience in the Central Inland Empire or Norco area, view our upcoming schedules and sign up today before divisions sell out!

entries.name: AYSO 136
entries.summary: Welcome to AYSO Fontana Region 136. We are very excited in your interest with our organization. We are all very dedicated in providing a Fun, Fair and Safe environment for your children as well as all our volunteers. We are striving to provide our community with up-to-date information to keep you well informed about our Region such as games schedules, meetings, coach and referee classes, fundraising information and so on, as well as weather updates, game day info and upcoming events. Feel free to navigate through our website since it's filled with lots of interesting information. Also, remember, all our staff are all here as volunteers, so please be patient, understanding and compassionate, for we are all doing our best to make this organization the best for your children.

entries.name: A.B. Miller High School
entries.summary: At A.B. Miller High School, we live by Miller PRIDE. We expect all students to demonstrate Participation, Respect, Integrity, Determination, and Empathy in the classroom, on campus, and throughout our community. These values guide our actions and help prepare students for success in school, in college and careers, and in life. Throughout the year, we will continue to foster these characteristics and celebrate students who exemplify the spirit of Miller PRIDE.

entries.name: Kaiser High School
entries.summary: Henry J. Kaiser High School was established in September 1999. Our school is named after the renowned industrialist Henry J. Kaiser, who played a significant role in the development of Fontana through his establishment of the Kaiser Steel Mill.

entries.name: Jurupa Hills High School
entries.summary: Jurupa Hills High School (JHHS) is one of five comprehensive high schools in the Fontana Unified School District, notable for its innovative design and distinguished programs. The school honors its historical roots with its name, derived from the first elementary school in southern Fontana, now the Fontana Adult School. JHHS features modern facilities, including collaborative student desks, a collegiate lecture hall, a 400-seat theater, and an athletic stadium with artificial turf.

entries.name: Summit High School
entries.summary: The mission of Summit High School is to foster a diverse and inclusive community where all students become compassionate, dedicated, and innovative leaders who are globally competitive and prepared through a rigorous academic environment that promotes collaboration and growth.

entries.name: Oak Grove Prepatory Academy
entries.summary:
Fontana Unified School District is proud to open a brand new, state-of-the-art secondary academy focused on innovation, creativity, and future-ready learning.

Through pathways in Information and Communication Technologies, and Health Science and Medical Technology, Arts, Media, and Entertainment, students will engage in hands-on, interdisciplinary learning experiences that prepare them for success in college, career, and beyond.

The academy also provides opportunities for students to accelerate their learning—taking high school courses during middle school and enrolling in college and university dual enrollment classes through our partnerships with California State University, San Bernardino and Chaffey College.

entries.name: Fontana Adult School
entries.summary: Adult education is powerful. Returning to education can be a transformative experience, opening doors to new opportunities and skills. It can also be scary. It's important to remember that we are here to help and it's never too late to start. Whether you're looking to advance your career, change fields, earn a high school diploma or GED, become a citizen or learn English, the best time to begin is now.

entries.name: Eric Birch High School
entries.summary: Eric Birch High School will provide a supportive alternative learning environment where every student can reach their full academic potential for college, career, and life by engaging in meaningful instruction, social emotional learning, and career skills development.

entries.name: Online Learning
entries.summary: Fontana Unified School District offers alternative education options to meet students' academic, medical, and personal circumstances while supporting progress toward graduation and educational success. Eric Birch High School, Independent Study, Online Learning, and Home & Hospital Instruction each serve different student needs.

entries.name: Alder Middle School

entries.name: Almeria Middle School
entries.summary: At Almeria Middle School, we are committed to creating a safe, nurturing, and inclusive environment where every student feels seen, supported, and valued. Our vision, “Learn today for success tomorrow,” guides everything we do. We believe that middle school is a pivotal time in a young person’s life, and we are here to guide our students with care, consistency, and compassion—from the classroom to the quad.
